meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 当你问起以前做过的事，Claude 会从历史会话里搜出记录清单（每条带编号和时间），筛出相关的几条，再按需拉取这些条目的时间线或完整详情，不会一次性把所有旧内容都倒出来。
howto.when: 当用户问的是之前会话里的事（而非当前对话），比如“这个问题以前解决过吗”“上次我们是怎么做的”等追溯旧记录的问题时触发。

say.text: 这个问题我们以前是不是修过？
say.note: Claude 会搜索历史记录并列出候选清单。

say.text: 上次我们怎么解决登录超时的？
say.note: 它会先找出相关记录，再按需打开详情。

say.text: 上周我们在 demo 项目里做了什么？
say.note: 按项目和日期过滤，列出当时的记录。

howto.what_en: When asked about past work, Claude searches old sessions and returns a list of record IDs. It filters to relevant items, then fetches their timelines or full details without dumping all history at once.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about previous sessions (not current chat), e.g. "did we ever fix this?", "how did we do X last time?", etc.

say_en.text: Had we ever fixed this auth bug before?
say_en.note: Runs a search and lists candidate records.

say_en.text: How did we solve the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Finds matching records, opens details for the chosen ones.

say_en.text: What did we do in the demo project last week?
say_en.note: Filters by project and date, then lists entries.
